capabilities: Draws walled towns, villages and harbour cities from a seed
Generates region, dungeon, spaceship and building floor-plan maps
Opens numbered places as notes with names, keepers and hooks
Plays maps solo with hidden rooms and secret-door searches
Saves player maps as PNG or Universal VTT files
extras: All map types, solo play and PNG export are free; the paid Pro key adds Universal VTT export and also works in the browser version and the Foundry module. Maps are drawn on-device from the seed; the plugin contacts its server only when checking a Pro key or mailing a lost one. Painted textures come from an image generator, while the plain look is drawn entirely by code.
problem: TTRPG game masters need consistent local maps and place notes for their campaigns, which otherwise means drawing them by hand or in a separate app.

relations.evidence: Its hex notes put a mapsmith block in each town and ruin
Atlas VTT imports it as it is, the battle-map plugin for Obsidian
Mapsmith for Foundry is a module that makes the scene from a seed
Roll20 takes it from Create Page, Upload Background

summary: Seed-based generator that draws town, region, dungeon, ship and building maps inside notes, with numbered places you can click for a name and a hook.
